XSS Test: Event Handler Injection

This page contains an element with an inline event handler. If the extension copies this handler unsanitized, it could execute.

Select this text: <p onmouseover="alert('XSS-EVENT')">malicious</p>

Note: The event handler above is HTML-escaped and does not execute. This tests whether the extension properly handles text that looks like XSS.

Expected Behavior:
  • No alert dialog should appear when hovering over the overlay text
  • Event handlers should not be copied to the overlay
  • The overlay should only show plain text content
